snippet.description:
In this video, G.Babu Sir (Cracked UPSC Thrice) explains the 360° approach to solving UPSC Prelims PYQs as part of PMP 2027 (Prelims Master Program).

- Instead of limiting your learning to the correct answer, understand how to:
- Analyse why all the other options are incorrect.
- Explore possible questions that can emerge from the same topic.
- Connect different concepts and expand your understanding.
- Use every PYQ as an opportunity to cover a wider part of the syllabus.

UPSC often tests the same themes through differently framed questions. A thorough understanding of all options can help you tackle unexpected questions with greater confidence.

This is the approach followed in PMP 2027, where questions are discussed through a comprehensive 360° perspective to maximise learning from every question.

Explore PMP 2027:
https://shorturl.at/ZHr3s
